_note: Version 4 planet (docs/V4_DESIGN.md section 1): the 2,560 m map. sim/world_v4.gd reads this file. Distances in metres, heights in metres, counts [min, max] drawn from the seed. Change a number here, not in code.
_note_scale: V4 section 2: on the v4 map new rooms are built at room_scale x the v3 radius (every size) and corridors corridor_scale x wider; the reference layout spreads by layout_scale. Older maps keep the v3 numbers. base_min_distance: an Outpost Kit is not deployed nearer than this to another base's core.
_note_corridor_scale: 1.25 when the wider corridor tubes go live with ART-HAB and RENDER (coordinator); 1.0 until then. The 1.5 x rooms are in buildings.json for every map.
_note_known_radius: Deposits within this distance of the landing are surveyed from the start; the others after a survey (sim state.deposits[i].surveyed).
_note_noise: Octaves of value noise: [cell metres, amplitude metres]. The sum is upsampled with cubic interpolation.

mountains._note: A range is a Gaussian ridge along a bent line. Its flanks are steeper than 0.6: no walk, no rover. Each range has 1..2 passes (a cut corridor with a slope under 0.35).

plateaus._note: Raised discs with cliffs (slope over 1). Each has 1..2 ramps (slope under 0.4). Good sun, windy.

deep_craters._note: Radius = half the width. Depth = radius x depth_ratio, clamped to depth. Flat floor inside floor x radius, a steep wall, a raised rim. One ramp in. Cold traps: water ice and helium-3 on the floor.

crevices._note: Long narrow cracks. Nobody walks or drives across; bridges or hoppers cross. Rare earths on the floor.

boulder_fields._note: Massive boulders (size = diameter). They block building and walking; rovers go round them.

_note_sun: Sun path of the v4 planet (sim.world.sun_dir). The view and the solar output use the same path. max_elev_deg is the noon elevation: low, so crater floors stay dark.
_note_radiation: mSv/h at 1 m above the ground (sim.world.rad_at). plain = the open plain; per_100m = extra per 100 m above the start plateau; rim = extra on a deep crater rim; deposits = peak at a uranium or thorium field, falling over its radius.
_note_deposit_items: What a mine takes from a deposit of each kind, the research it needs first, and units per batch (default: the recipe output). A deposit without a kind (v2, v3 maps) gives iron ore.

wreck.name: Wreck
wreck.desc: A crashed lander. Salvage and a data core.

derelict_probe.name: Derelict probe
derelict_probe.desc: An old survey probe. Blueprint fragments and a data core.

meteorite_field.name: Meteorite field
meteorite_field.desc: Fresh meteorites among the boulders. The samples hold exotic crystal.

cave.name: Cave
cave.desc: A cave at a mountain foot. Somebody must walk in: ice and exotic crystal.

anomaly.name: Anomaly
anomaly.desc: A strange signal, often on high ground. A scientist must visit it: data cores and research points.

rich_deposit.name: Rich deposit
rich_deposit.desc: A seam that the orbiters did not see. A visit adds a rich deposit.

_note_explore: V4 milestone 7 (sim/explore.gd). Fog cells of fog_cell m; colonists outside reveal reveal_walk m round them, rovers reveal_rover m, hoppers reveal_hopper m. A satellite with an uplink reveals one of the bands strips every band_s s. POIs: count per kind, placed poi_min_dist..poi_max_dist from the landing, poi_spacing apart; visited within visit_r m by the right people (need: any, on_foot, scientist); finds go into the vehicle there, else onto the ground.
_note_materials: Where each material lies (tier, place, count, amount). Basic on the safe plain, mid at moderate distance and risk, high-end only in dangerous places.

rare_earth._note: one per crevice, next to it

exotic._note: one per mountain range, on its highest part
